None of the toilets are wheelchair accessible.

findings.value: One 20cm step up to the front door; a ramp is available if you ask the door team. Level access to the ground-floor bar and facilities. The downstairs club room (open Friday and Saturday nights) is reached by stairs only. Strobe and smoke can be turned off if you ask in advance. No designated quiet area; a small welfare area is in the downstairs bathroom on Thursday to Saturday. Free entry for PAs and access workers, and free concession tickets for low or no income, arranged by email beforehand.
